text:
mira: pushing release image for release/2026.03.14 to ECR now. CI finished, just triggering deploy-bot to publish attestation :eyes:
deploy-bot: [publish-attempt] repo=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/release tag=2026.03.14 status=REJECTED reason=provenance-signature-mismatch manifest_digest=sha256:deadbeef
jon: ugh, signature mismatch again? did we switch base image or the provenance signing keys changed?
tiago: change window is open until 12:30 PST, can we hold canary?
mira: canary already went out to 10% — let's pause the rollout. mira: @deploy-bot pause-rollout release/2026.03.14 :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: rollout paused for release/2026.03.14 by mira
ash: (cc @ash) any idea what changed in the build? Ash: we updated buildpack to 0.8.1 yesterday, could be related.
ash: typo — meant ash: we updated buildpack to 0.8.1 yesterday, could be related.
ash: also adding: the RPM & SBOM steps ran under a different runner image, might affect provenance.
jon: plan: retag image with explicit digest from CI artifact storage and re-run attestation. If attestation passes, we can resume. If not, rollback to 2026.03.13.
mira: agree. I'll try a retag + push to a temporary tag to re-trigger provenance guard.
ci-bot: re-triggering pipeline #456 with RETAG=true (requested by mira)
ci-bot: build #456 started -> pushing artifact to gcs://redwood-ci/artifacts/456/release.tar.gz
jon: commands I ran locally for repro:
```bash
# fetch artifact, retag, push to ECR
docker pull gcr.io/redwood/release@sha256:abc123def456
docker tag gcr.io/redwood/release@sha256:abc123def456 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/release:2026.03.14-retag
docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/release:2026.03.14-retag
```
mira: pushed retagged image and requested attestation verification. deploy-bot should pick it up.
deploy-bot: [attestation-check] repo=.../redwood/release tag=2026.03.14-retag status=PASSED signer=provenance-svc-v2
tiago: nice. can we swap the production tag to the retagged image or just resume original tag?
jon: safer to pin the production tag to the new image digest: update routing table to point to sha256:abc123def456. We should avoid reusing the same tag until we confirm root cause.
nash: agree. Also add a follow-up to pin base-image digest in Dockerfile to avoid flakey provenance in future.
mira: opened ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-1122 to track root cause and docs updates.
nash: small note for release notes: mention buildpack bump and that we verified attestation after retag.
nash: draft for release notes line: "Fixed: Attestation mismatch due to buildpack bump; release image re-published and verified."
jon: I'm going to run a quick smoke test on canary now that attestation passed.
tiago: hold on canary — we paused earlier. mira: please resume canary when ready.
mira: resuming canary at 11:48 PST. deploy-bot: resume-rollout release/2026.03.14
deploy-bot: rollout resumed (10% canary)
ci-bot: build #456 completed successfully, artifacts stored.
mira: will monitor metrics for 30m before increasing to 50%.
jon: if anything spikes, we rollback to 2026.03.13 via pinned digest.
nash: thanks all. action items saved in REL-1122. :thumbsup:
